build_absolute_position_embedder: build a python module to create sinusoidal position embeddings for spatial coordinates using AbsolutePositionEmbedder
create_feedforward_net: create a FeedForwardNet module with GELU activation and configurable MLP ratio for transformer architectures
build_transformer_block: build a TransformerBlock with multi-head self-attention and feed-forward network supporting full or windowed attention modes
build_transformer_cross_block: build a TransformerCrossBlock with self-attention, cross-attention, and feed-forward network for encoder-decoder transformer models
test_transformer_blocks: test the TransformerBlock and TransformerCrossBlock forward passes with gradient checkpointing enabled
